_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Royal Trials#000.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Skyraider Guard と話す。

Royal Trials#001.src: Back off! No'ne enters 'til the pirate queen is chosen. What's a landwalker like you doin' here?
Royal Trials#001.dst: 下がりな！海賊女王が決まるまで誰も入れないよ。あんたみたいな陸の者がここで何してんだい？
Royal Trials#001.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#002.src: Participate? Are ye crazy? Ain't no way a landlubber is wearing the crown.
Royal Trials#002.dst: 参加？正気かい？陸者が王冠をかぶるなんてありえないね。
Royal Trials#002.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#003.src: Off with ya now! Before I call the gals to gut you. And dun' go wandering around chatting to any skyraiders!
Royal Trials#003.dst: とっとと失せな！仲間を呼んで腹を裂かせる前にね。それと Skyraider に話しかけてうろつくんじゃないよ！
Royal Trials#003.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#005.src: Yer wantin' to be pirate queen, ye? Don' worry, I can help ye.
Royal Trials#005.dst: 海賊女王になりたいんだろ？心配すんな、あたいが手を貸すよ。
Royal Trials#005.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#006.src: Y'see, the other pirates ain't fit for the role. They're dumb 'n weak. All they've got is looks.
Royal Trials#006.dst: いいかい、他の海賊どもはその器じゃない。バカで弱い。見た目だけさ。
Royal Trials#006.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#007.src: Yer got the lot! Looks and talent.
Royal Trials#007.dst: あんたは全部持ってる！見た目も才能も。
Royal Trials#007.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#008.src: Y'know, the guard, she's dumb too. A simple disguise will fool 'er. Issue is, ye dun' look like a skyraider at all!
Royal Trials#008.dst: あの見張りもバカでね。簡単な変装で騙せる。問題は、あんたが Skyraider に全然見えないことさ！
Royal Trials#008.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#009.src: Yer in luck, though. A skyraider will sell anything for a price - just look around the town and see if ye can persuade anyone to part with their outfit.
Royal Trials#009.dst: でも運がいいね。Skyraider は金さえ出せば何でも売る― 町を回って、誰かに服を譲ってもらえないか頼んでみな。
Royal Trials#009.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#010.src: Look around the skyraider town at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find a pirate outfit.
Royal Trials#010.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Skyraider の町を回り、海賊の服を手に入れる。

Royal Trials#011.src: Aye? A landwalker, wanderin' around our base? Whatcha' want?
Royal Trials#011.dst: ああ？陸の者がうちの基地をうろついてる？何の用だい？
Royal Trials#011.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#013.src: ... aye, I suppose I could be tempted to pass it on to ye... for a price.
Royal Trials#013.dst: …まあ、譲ってやらなくもないね… 代わりのもんがあれば。
Royal Trials#013.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#014.src: Here, these are what I'd trade it to ye for.
Royal Trials#014.dst: ほら、これと交換なら譲るよ。
Royal Trials#014.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#015.src: If yer thinkin' emeralds... [{~} Emerald Blocks] seems like a fair price, heh.
Royal Trials#015.dst: エメラルドなら… [{~} Emerald Blocks] ってとこが妥当だね、へへ。
Royal Trials#015.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#016.src: Of course, if you're running low on funds, how about ye grab me [{~} Dragonling Eggs] instead? Y'know, the ingredient. I'm 'oping to raise some 'o the lil critters!
Royal Trials#016.dst: もちろん金欠なら、代わりに [{~} Dragonling Eggs] を持ってきな。ほら、素材のやつさ。あのちっこいのを何匹か育ててみたいんだ！
Royal Trials#016.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#017.src: But if neither of them tickle ye fancy... I've always wanted [{~} Shiny Shell] - they're just so sparkly! Ye can find them in the cave south-east of here, beside the ladders.
Royal Trials#017.dst: どっちも気に入らなきゃ… ずっと [{~} Shiny Shell] が欲しかったんだ― キラキラしてんのさ！ここから南東の洞窟、はしごの横で見つかるよ。
Royal Trials#017.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#018.src: Ye can get me one o' those three, landwalker, and ye can have my outfit!
Royal Trials#018.dst: その三つのどれか一つを持ってきな、陸の者。そしたらこの服はあんたのもんだ！
Royal Trials#018.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#019.src: Give an item to Egpla at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Royal Trials#019.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Egpla にアイテムを渡す。

Royal Trials#020.src: So, landwalker, are ye ready to pay up? I can see emeralds in ye pocket, hand 'em over.
Royal Trials#020.dst: さて陸の者、払う気になったかい？ポケットにエメラルドが見えてるよ、よこしな。
Royal Trials#020.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#021.src: Alrigh'! Those're exactly what I've been lookin' for. Give it here, lemme have a look...
Royal Trials#021.dst: よし！まさに探してたもんだ。こっちによこしな、見せてみ…
Royal Trials#021.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#022.src: Aye, landwalker! Is that the sparkle of a shiny shell I spot in ye pocket?! Lemme have a look...
Royal Trials#022.dst: おや、陸の者！ポケットで光ってるのは shiny shell かい？！見せてみな…
Royal Trials#022.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#023.src: Alright, landwalker. Ye can have me outfit. 'ere, lemme just get changed inside.
Royal Trials#023.dst: よし、陸の者。服はあんたにやるよ。ほら、中で着替えてくるから。
Royal Trials#023.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#024.src: Here ye go, landlubber. I hope ye get some kinda use out of it, whatever ye want it for.
Royal Trials#024.dst: ほらよ、陸者。何に使うか知らないが、役に立つといいね。
Royal Trials#024.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#026.src: Another contestant, eh? That outfit looks a bit funny on ye, but I'll let yer in. Hurry up!
Royal Trials#026.dst: また参加者かい？その服、ちょっと妙に見えるけど、通してやるよ。急ぎな！
Royal Trials#026.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#028.src: Ugh! Ye can't be the queen, ye can barely fly an airship!
Royal Trials#028.dst: はっ！あんたが女王になれるもんか、飛行船もろくに飛ばせないくせに！
Royal Trials#028.speaker: Angry Contestant

Royal Trials#029.src: No! I'll be the queen! I'm much more qualified than any of you sky rats!
Royal Trials#029.dst: 違う！女王はあたしだ！空のドブネズミどもよりずっとふさわしいよ！
Royal Trials#029.speaker: Angry Contestant

Royal Trials#030.src: Listen to the Trials Overseer's speech.
Royal Trials#030.dst: 試練監督官の演説を聞く。

Royal Trials#031.src: Gather round, ladies. The next Queen is about to be selected!
Royal Trials#031.dst: 集まりな、お嬢さんたち。次の女王がいよいよ選ばれるよ！
Royal Trials#031.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#032.src: As ye know, our previous queen suffered a... nasty fate, murdered on her very own airship by a Wynn soldier.
Royal Trials#032.dst: 知っての通り、先代の女王は… ひどい最期を遂げた。自分の飛行船で Wynn の兵士に殺されたんだ。
Royal Trials#032.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#033.src: But in the ashes of her honor, a new queen shall rise! Three trials. That's what ye all face now.
Royal Trials#033.dst: だが彼女の誇りの灰から、新たな女王が立つ！試練は三つ。それがあんたらの挑むものさ。
Royal Trials#033.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#034.src: Only one, who passes all trials laid before her, will pass and gain the title of Skyraider Queen.
Royal Trials#034.dst: 課された試練を全て越えた一人だけが、Skyraider の女王の称号を得る。
Royal Trials#034.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#035.src: Now, I introduce ye all to the first trial, to test yer capability at a vital skill for queenship - combat!
Royal Trials#035.dst: では最初の試練を紹介しよう。女王に欠かせない技― 戦闘の腕を試すよ！
Royal Trials#035.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#037.src: Defeat the armory room of the combat challenge.
Royal Trials#037.dst: 戦闘の試練の武器庫の部屋を突破する。

Royal Trials#038.src: Defeat the brig room of the combat challenge.
Royal Trials#038.dst: 戦闘の試練の営倉の部屋を突破する。

Royal Trials#039.src: Defeat the cockpit room of the combat challenge.
Royal Trials#039.dst: 戦闘の試練の操縦室の部屋を突破する。

Royal Trials#040.src: Listen to the trials overseer's speech.
Royal Trials#040.dst: 試練監督官の演説を聞く。

Royal Trials#041.src: Arr, that weeded out the weak. A queen must be strong to lead.
Royal Trials#041.dst: よし、弱い奴はふるい落とされた。女王は強くなきゃ率いられない。
Royal Trials#041.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#042.src: Now, to the second challenge - the task of flight! Ye can't be a queen if ye can't fly yer airship!
Royal Trials#042.dst: さて、二つ目の試練― 飛行だ！自分の飛行船を飛ばせなきゃ女王にはなれないよ！
Royal Trials#042.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#043.src: Make sure ye bring yer eyes, girls, one false move and death awaits.
Royal Trials#043.dst: しっかり目を開けときな、お嬢さんたち。一つのミスが命取りだよ。
Royal Trials#043.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#044.src: This task should get rid of the rest of ye unworthy.
Royal Trials#044.dst: これで残りの半端者も片付くだろうね。
Royal Trials#044.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#045.dst: 飛行の試練を突破する。

Royal Trials#046.src: Listen to the trials overseer's speech.
Royal Trials#046.dst: 試練監督官の演説を聞く。

Royal Trials#047.src: Well lookie here, an amateur made it through her flight.
Royal Trials#047.dst: おやおや、素人が飛行を越えてきたね。
Royal Trials#047.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#048.src: Well let’s see how you hold up in the final task ladies.
Royal Trials#048.dst: さて、最後の試練でどこまで耐えられるか見せてもらおうか。
Royal Trials#048.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#049.src: Yer ain’ a pirate at all if ye can't steal, but this is different.
Royal Trials#049.dst: 盗めなきゃ海賊じゃないが、今回はわけが違う。
Royal Trials#049.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#050.src: This is the real deal. Stealin’ from a highly secure mansion.
Royal Trials#050.dst: 今回は本番だ。厳重な屋敷からの盗みさ。
Royal Trials#050.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#051.src: Yer job is to steal a priceless treasure from the richest family in the sky.
Royal Trials#051.dst: 空一の金持ち一家から、値のつけられない宝を盗むんだ。
Royal Trials#051.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#052.src: We'll be waiting with a getaway airship at the extraction point, everyone else'll left behind.
Royal Trials#052.dst: 脱出地点で逃走用の飛行船を待たせとく、他の奴らは置いてくよ。
Royal Trials#052.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#053.src: Remember, this be the real thing, and the consequences of failure will be severe. Good luck, ladies.
Royal Trials#053.dst: いいかい、これは本番だ、失敗すりゃただじゃ済まない。幸運を、お嬢さんたち。
Royal Trials#053.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#054.src: This here is the garden you we'll tunnel into, and yer'll 'ave to find a way into the Mansion, maybe yer can just ask nicely, heh.
Royal Trials#054.dst: ここが地下から掘って入る庭だ。屋敷への入り方は自分で探しな、丁寧に頼めば入れてくれるかもね、へへ。
Royal Trials#054.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#055.src: Then yer'll have to sneak through these corridors to reach the treasure - and don't let the guards find yer, or they'll lock yer up and throw away the key.
Royal Trials#055.dst: それからこの廊下を忍んで宝まで行く― 衛兵に見つかるんじゃないよ、牢にぶち込まれて鍵を捨てられちまう。
Royal Trials#055.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#056.src: This, o' course, is the mythical treasure that yer gonna want to grab and get outta here, stat. I'm sure there'll be some extra defenses, though.
Royal Trials#056.dst: で、これがもちろん、ひっつかんで即ずらかるべき伝説の宝だ。まあ、守りは余分についてるだろうけどね。
Royal Trials#056.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#057.src: And finally yer'll have to escape outta this window right 'ere - I'll be waitin' with an airship to carry all of ye out.
Royal Trials#057.dst: 最後にこの窓から脱出する― あたしが飛行船で待ってて、全員を運び出すよ。
Royal Trials#057.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#059.src: Aye', think ye ready to try grabbin' that treasure, eh? Just 'ead outta this hole and try to find yer way into the mansion.
Royal Trials#059.dst: よう、宝を取りに行く気になったかい？この穴から出て、屋敷への入り方を探しな。
Royal Trials#059.speaker: Skyraider

Royal Trials#060.src: Sneak past the guards and steal the treasure.
Royal Trials#060.dst: 衛兵をかわして宝を盗む。

Royal Trials#061.src: Oi', you! Whatcha' think yer' doin' sneakin' around these parts? This be a restricted area! Yer' headed to the jail cell!
Royal Trials#061.dst: おい、そこのお前！こんな所をこそこそ何してる？ここは立入禁止区域だ！牢屋行きだぞ！
Royal Trials#061.speaker: Mansion Guard

Royal Trials#062.src: Get the treasure to the trials overseer outside of the mansion's window.
Royal Trials#062.dst: 屋敷の窓の外にいる試練監督官へ宝を届ける。

Royal Trials#063.src: Aye', men! Tha' treasure has been stolen! Prepare the defenses!
Royal Trials#063.dst: おい、野郎ども！宝が盗まれた！守りを固めろ！
Royal Trials#063.speaker: Mansion Guard

Royal Trials#064.src: Aye, we caught the nasty thief! We'll be lockin' him up till' he rots!
Royal Trials#064.dst: よし、薄汚い泥棒を捕まえたぞ！朽ち果てるまで閉じ込めてやる！
Royal Trials#064.speaker: Mansion Guard

Royal Trials#065.src: Ah, I thought yer might be the first one back. Yer got a queenly look about ye...
Royal Trials#065.dst: おや、一番に戻るのはあんただと思ってたよ。女王の風格があるね…
Royal Trials#065.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#066.src: Head to the airship behind me, lassie. We'll wait a second before the others.
Royal Trials#066.dst: 後ろの飛行船に乗りな、嬢ちゃん。他の奴らを少し待つよ。
Royal Trials#066.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#067.src: Exit the Mansion onto the airship outside.
Royal Trials#067.dst: 屋敷を出て、外の飛行船に乗る。

Royal Trials#068.src: Listen to the trials overseer's speech.
Royal Trials#068.dst: 試練監督官の演説を聞く。

Royal Trials#069.src: Aha! I figured it'd be ye to win o'er the rest of that lot… Ye've earned the proper sovereignty of bein' our ruler, our queen of the Skyraiders.
Royal Trials#069.dst: はは！残りの連中に勝つのはあんただと思ってたよ… 我らの支配者、Skyraider の女王の座を見事に勝ち取ったね。
Royal Trials#069.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#070.src: Don't be worryin', we got this airship armoured somethin' heavy, and we’re miles away from their cannons… Nothin' to be afraid of, we're safe in this ship.
Royal Trials#070.dst: 心配いらないよ、この飛行船はがっちり装甲してあるし、奴らの大砲から何マイルも離れてる… 怖がることはない、この船なら安全さ。
Royal Trials#070.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#071.src: But, first things first, let’s take a look inside that fancy box ye got, see what mythical treasures lay guarded behind those grubby guardsmen, shall we?
Royal Trials#071.dst: でもまずは、あんたが手に入れた立派な箱の中を見てみようか。薄汚い衛兵どもが守ってた伝説の宝ってのは何なのか、ね？
Royal Trials#071.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#073.src: I hafta wonder now if this weren't bein' guarded for a bit of a nefarious reason. This be... Quite the weapon. It'd be deadly if this got used.
Royal Trials#073.dst: こいつは何か悪だくみのために守られてたんじゃないかと思えてきたよ。これは… 大した武器だ。使われたら恐ろしいことになる。
Royal Trials#073.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#074.src: Well, thanks to ye, us Skyraiders might have it now, but using this weapon against civilization would be beyond terrible. We might be pirates but we ain't heartless!
Royal Trials#074.dst: まあ、あんたのおかげで Skyraider のものになったかもしれないが、この武器を文明に向けるなんてひどすぎる。海賊だけど、心まで無くしちゃいないよ！
Royal Trials#074.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#075.src: I think we'll just have to keep this locked up nice n' tight once we get back. We'll be sure to tie this little cataclysm-in-a-box down much safer th'n those idiot men did.
Royal Trials#075.dst: 戻ったら、こいつはしっかり封じておくしかないね。この箱入りの大災厄は、あのバカな男どもよりずっと厳重に縛っとくよ。
Royal Trials#075.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#076.src: Aha! Just gettin' back now. Let's head down and start the ceremony, shall we?
Royal Trials#076.dst: はは！ちょうど戻ったね。降りて式を始めようか？
Royal Trials#076.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#077.src: I am pleased to introduce our {~}th Skyraider Queen. Fer the sake of our people, let her reign last more than two weeks.
Royal Trials#077.dst: 我らが第 {~} 代 Skyraider の女王を紹介しよう。民のためにも、今度の治世は二週間より長く続きますように。
Royal Trials#077.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#078.src: I, on behalf on the rest of the Skyraider people, have the honor of decoratin' you with the highest decoration of the Skyraiders, The Queen's Headpiece.
Royal Trials#078.dst: Skyraider の民を代表して、Skyraider 最高の栄誉、The Queen's Headpiece を授ける光栄にあずかる。
Royal Trials#078.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#079.src: Please use your sovereignty to lead us to the riches we deserve.
Royal Trials#079.dst: どうかその統治で、我らをふさわしい富へ導いておくれ。
Royal Trials#079.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#081.src: Yer Majesty. What an honour to have such a beautiful queen.
Royal Trials#081.dst: 陛下。こんなに美しい女王を戴けるとは光栄です。
Royal Trials#081.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#082.src: Now, we must crown ye, and give you yer reward.
Royal Trials#082.dst: さあ、戴冠して、褒美を授けないとね。
Royal Trials#082.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#083.src: Benefits of being a queen I 'spose.
Royal Trials#083.dst: 女王になった特典ってやつかね。
Royal Trials#083.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#084.dst: どうぞお受け取りください、陛下。
Royal Trials#084.speaker: Trials Overseer
